name: Ano Hi Mitsuketa Hana no Namae wa
original_name: あの日見つけた花の名前は
source:
Jintan and Menma are on summer vacation playing hide and seek.
But it's no ordinary version of the game. Whoever was found
had to give the other a "prize", escalating into more obscene...

Try to find Menma in 7 locations. (open map adventure game) 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072773.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
仁太和面码在暑假玩捉迷藏。但这不是普通的捉迷藏。被找到的人必须给另一个人一个“奖赏”，逐渐升级为更色情的内容……在7个地点中找到面码。（开放地图冒险游戏）

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072773.html]DLsite English[/url]]
